biography.bioParagraph1: While the job titles have changed over the years, my nearly 15-year career in local television has been centered around two things in one way or another: growing viewership or growing revenue.
biography.bioParagraph2: This has consisted of everything from producing promotional materials, TV commercials, sponsored segments, and special interest TV programs, to showrunner, executive producer, media sales and marketing.
biography.bioParagraph3: Additionally an independent filmmaker, I've been able to secure distribution for my debut documentary, Farming Freedom, which is available beginning in 2026.
biography.bioParagraph4: With more than a decade's experience of managing projects from inception to launch, I look forward to bringing that very experience to Jackson Metro's newest podcast studio for anyone seeking to produce professional shows that are distribution ready for any platform.

production1.title: Farming Freedom
production1.longDescription: Farming Freedom follows the untold story of Black land loss across the American South — tracing how systemic dispossession displaced generations of farming families, and the activists working to reclaim that legacy.

production2.title: Asymmetric Care: A History of Bias
production2.longDescription: Asymmetric Care examines the long and documented history of medical bias against Black women in America — exploring how systemic inequities in pain treatment, diagnosis, and care have persisted across generations, and the voices working to change that reality.

production3.title: Farming Freedom: Roots & Returns
production3.imageAlt: Farming Freedom: Roots & Returns Documentary Poster
production3.longDescription: Farming Freedom: Roots & Returns explores what Black land ownership can truly yield — from subsistence skills like gardening, small livestock, and aquaculture, to revenue-generating opportunities through market farming, cattle, and beyond. A practical and inspiring look at how reclaiming land can transform lives.

speaking.speakerBio: With nearly 15 years in local television — from executive producer to independent filmmaker — Kayla Turner Thomas brings firsthand expertise in storytelling, media, and distribution to every stage she steps on.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.body: The James & Kayla Thomas Foundation was built on a simple belief — that people, when given the right resources, opportunities, and support, can transform their lives and their communities. We exist to bridge gaps, amplify voices, and invest in the kind of change that lasts. Through education, media, health, and community development, we are committed to building a foundation that serves people first.
